exposure: volume of intravenous fluids during labor
volume of solute injected during Labor
outcome: neonatal weight loss up to day 3
cohort: 150 mother-infant pairs with term, low-risk pregnancies and breastfeeding, recruited between January 1, 2016 and July 31, 2016 at a university hospital center
finding: A significant association was found between the volume of intravenous fluids administered during labor and increased neonatal weight loss up to three days after birth.
mod_finding: The study found an association between higher volumes of intravenous fluids administered during labor and increased risk of neonatal weight loss, but did not examine mode of delivery.
